jobs.title: Platform Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:
职位描述 (Job Description)
你将全面负责内容中台产品矩阵（涵盖CMS内容管理、DAM数字资产、TMS翻译管理等系统）的规划与演进，为前台业务（官方APP、Web官网、微信小程序/公众号等）提供统一、高效、高质量的内容供应链支撑。
同时，你将作为AI+内容的先锋，探索并落地AIGC（AI生成内容）与智能化内容治理在度假区复杂业务场景中的应用，用技术驱动内容生产效率的飞跃，为全球游客打造卓越的数字体验。

核心职责 (Key Responsibilities)
1. 内容中台产品规划与迭代
- 负责度假区内容中台（CMS、DAM、TMS等）的产品规划、功能设计与全生命周期管理。
- 深入理解业务需求，抽象通用能力，构建灵活、可扩展的内容模型与元数据体系，支撑多站点、多语言、多终端（APP/Web/WeChat）的内容统一管理与高效分发。
- 持续优化内容生产、审核、发布工作流，提升跨团队协作效率，确保全球游客获取到准确、一致、生动的度假区资讯。
2. AI辅助内容生成与治理落地
- 跟踪AIGC前沿技术与行业最佳实践，结合度假区业务场景（如：商品描述生成、多语言翻译、图片/视频素材处理、SEO优化等），设计AI辅助内容创作与治理的产品方案。
- 推动AI能力在中台系统的无缝集成，实现从“人工生产”到“人机协同”的范式升级，降低内容运营成本，提升内容个性化与时效性。
3. 多渠道数字体验交付
- 作为内容与前端体验的桥梁，制定统一的内容API规范与分发策略，确保内容在不同渠道（APP、Web、微信生态等）的一致渲染与极致体验。
- 协同前端、客户端团队，探索组件化、个性化推荐等能力，提升最终用户的浏览与交互体验。
4. 生态协同与项目管理
- 深入理解内容创作者、运营人员、翻译团队及开发团队的痛点，收集并分析需求，输出高质量的产品文档（PRD）、原型及交互说明。
- 协调内部研发、设计、测试及外部供应商资源，确保项目按时、高质量交付，并持续进行数据追踪与产品迭代。
任职要求 (Qualifications)
1. 经验背景
- 本科及以上学历，计算机、信息管理、数字媒体或相关专业优先。
- 3年以上中后台产品经理经验，必须具备CMS（内容管理系统）、DAM（数字资产管理系统）或TMS（翻译管理系统）等至少一类系统的从0到1或大型迭代经验。
- 有文旅、电商、零售或大型品牌官网等“重内容、重体验”行业经验者优先。
2. 专业技能
- 熟悉内容供应链全流程，对多语言、多站点、多渠道的内容管理架构有深刻理解。
- 具备优秀的逻辑抽象能力，能将复杂的业务场景抽象为通用的中台产品能力。
- 熟悉Headless CMS（无头CMS）、内容API化、Jamstack等现代内容架构理念者加分。
3. AI产品思维（加分项）
-对生成式AI（LLM、多模态生成等）有浓厚兴趣，有AIGC产品落地经验（如：智能写作助手、AI作图、智能审核、知识库问答等）者优先。
能够清晰定义AI能力的人机交互边界与内容安全治理策略。
4. 综合素质
- 出色的跨部门沟通与协调能力，能够用技术语言和业务语言与不同角色顺畅对话。
- 结果导向，具备良好的数据敏感度，能通过数据分析驱动产品优化。
- 英语听说读写流利，能熟练阅读英文技术文档及海外产品资料，具备良好的英文口语沟通能力，适应国际化工作环境。

jobs.title: Product Manager Insurance Services
jobs.description:
Job Description:
DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

DXC's Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) helps insurers around the world modernize and run their core operations at scale by combining deep industry expertise, proven software platforms, and innovative AI-driven solutions. A global market leader in core insurance platforms, ISB delivers solutions across policy administration, claims, billing, analytics, and digital engagement supporting Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets. You’ll directly shape how the world's leading insurers operate by helping to transform the policy, underwriting, and claims systems that millions of people rely on every day.

As a Product Manager, Insurance Services within DXC Technology's Insurance Software and Business Process Services (BPS) organization, you will   be responsible for   managing the Insurance Services roadmap and ensuring successful delivery of capabilities that meet customer needs, business   objectives , and operational requirements. Working closely with Product Leadership, Architecture, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success teams, you will translate business requirements into scalable product capabilities and technical solutions that support modernization and operational transformation.

This role requires a strong blend of product management, business analysis, solution design, and technical leadership skills. The successful candidate will lead customer discovery, requirements gathering, business process improvement, backlog management, release planning, and stakeholder alignment activities while partnering closely with Architecture and Engineering teams to deliver API-driven, microservices-based solutions that improve business outcomes and customer experience.

The ideal candidate has experience applying modern Product Management techniques including customer discovery, collaborative discovery workshops, user story mapping, rapid prototyping, requirements decomposition, Agile delivery practices, and continuous backlog refinement. This individual must be comfortable working across business and technical teams to define solutions, prioritize investments, and drive successful execution.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Services Roadmap and Delivery Management

- Own and manage the Insurance Services roadmap, backlog, priorities, and release plans.

- Partner with Product Leadership to translate strategic   objectives   into actionable product and service initiatives.

- Define and prioritize features, enhancements, integrations, and operational improvements based on customer requirements, business value, technical feasibility, and organizational priorities.

- Lead roadmap planning, backlog grooming, release readiness activities, and stakeholder communications.

- Maintain backlog quality and readiness within Jira, ensuring work is properly refined, prioritized, and aligned with delivery   objectives .

- Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Delivery, and Operations teams to ensure successful execution of roadmap commitments.

- Manage dependencies, risks, technical constraints, and competing priorities across multiple initiatives.

- Support annual planning, release planning, and portfolio prioritization activities.

- Monitor roadmap progress and communicate status, risks, milestones, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.

Product Discovery, Requirements, and Process Design

- Lead customer discovery activities to understand business needs, operational challenges, workflow inefficiencies, and modernization opportunities.

- Facilitate collaborative discovery workshops with customers, business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and operational teams.

- Gather, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements that support scalable solution development.

- Utilize modern Product Management practices including User Story Mapping, customer journey mapping, process modeling, and design thinking techniques.

- Create user stories, epics, acceptance criteria, process flows, capability maps, and solution requirements that clearly communicate business   objectives   to technical teams.

- Drive Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) initiatives by   identifying   opportunities for process simplification, automation, workflow optimization, and operational transformation.

- Partner with stakeholders to   validate   proposed solutions through rapid prototyping, proof-of-concept activities, and iterative feedback cycles.

- Ensure traceability between business   objectives , customer requirements, technical solutions, and delivered outcomes.

Technology and Modernization Enablement

- Develop and   maintain   a strong understanding of DXC Insurance Services platforms, APIs, integration frameworks, workflow solutions, and shared technology services.

- Partner with Architecture and Engineering teams to define scalable solutions   leveraging   API-first, microservices-based, and cloud-enabled architectures.

- Participate in solution design discussions involving APIs, integrations, event-driven architectures, workflow automation, data services, AI-enabled capabilities, and modernization initiatives.

- Define and prioritize requirements for system integrations, APIs, workflow automation, and reusable business services.

- Support the evolution of reusable business capabilities, shared components, services, integrations, and technical accelerators.

- Collaborate with technical teams to evaluate modernization opportunities, technical debt reduction, cloud adoption strategies, and platform improvements.

- Ensure product requirements align with architecture standards, security requirements, compliance obligations, and operational support models.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Execution

- Collaborate across Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, Business Process Services, and Customer Success teams.

- Facilitate prioritization discussions, backlog refinement sessions, sprint planning activities, and stakeholder decision-making processes.

- Balance customer needs, operational   objectives , technical constraints, and strategic priorities when making product decisions.

- Communicate complex business and technical concepts effectively across executive, operational, and technical audiences.

- Coordinate execution activities   required   to deliver roadmap commitments on time and within scope.

- Support customer adoption, go-to-market readiness, product demonstrations, and strategic customer engagements.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business , Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or   a related   field.

- 7-10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Solution Design, Software Delivery, or related disciplines.

- Proven experience gathering and translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Experience   facilitating   customer discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and cross-functional solution design activities.

- Strong experience managing product roadmaps, Agile backlogs, release planning, and cross-functional delivery efforts.

- Demonstrated ability to work effectively across business and technical teams to deliver complex initiatives.

- Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and facilitation skills.

- Experience supporting customer engagements, product demonstrations, RFP responses, and strategic growth initiatives.

Technical Skills and Experience

Required

- Strong experience with Agile Product Management and Product Owner practices.

- Advanced experience using Jira for backlog management, sprint planning, release planning, workflow management, and backlog grooming.

- Expertise   in User Story Mapping, Epic decomposition, story refinement, acceptance criteria development, and backlog prioritization.

- Experience conducting customer discovery, collaborative workshops,   requirements   elicitation, and solution definition activities.

- Strong understanding of REST APIs, API lifecycle management, integration patterns, and API-first solution design.

- Experience working in environments leveraging   microservices   architectures, service-oriented architectures, and distributed systems.

- Understanding of   event-driven   architectures , workflow orchestration, and enterprise integration approaches.

- Experience creating process models, workflow diagrams, capability maps, business requirements, and solution documentation.

- Ability to partner effectively with architects and engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver technical capabilities.

- Experience supporting cloud-based platforms and SaaS delivery models.

- Familiarity with AI-enabled workflows, automation technologies, analytics solutions, and digital transformation initiatives.

Preferred

- Experience supporting insurance operations, insurance technology solutions, or business process services environments.

- Experience working on large-scale modernization, digital transformation, API enablement, or cloud migration initiatives.

- Familiarity with DXC Assure solutions and the broader insurance technology ecosystem.

- Experience supporting platform modernization, system integration, and operational transformation programs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager-Knowledge/Data
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Senior Product Manager
OASIS Platform  ·  DXC Technology

About OASIS
OASIS is DXC’s internal agentic AI platform, built for our delivery workforce. It supports enterprise clients across Infrastructure, Workplace, BPS, Cybersecurity, and Applications. We compete with platforms like Glean, Moveworks, and IBM watsonx Orchestrate, and we’re staking out our own position as an agentic platform that knows where the user is.
About the team
You’ll join a small, cross-functional product team operating with startup energy inside a global company. PM ownership spans AI Assist, Client Experience, and Knowledge. You’ll partner closely with Design, Engineering, and senior leadership across DXC to turn product strategy into shipped capabilities and measurable impact. You’ll report to the Director of Product Management and User Experience.
The role
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a major OASIS vertical end-to-end. You’ll define product vision, strategy, and roadmap; identify the highest-value opportunities; and lead execution from concept through launch and iteration. You won’t inherit a fully formed product. You’ll shape what we build, who it serves, how we differentiate, and how we measure success.
This is a senior IC role with meaningful strategic influence and clear ownership. The team is lean, the problem space is high potential, and the pace is fast. You’ll own one of the most consequential product areas in OASIS, partnering across leadership, design, and engineering to turn strategy into measurable business and user outcomes.
What you’ll do
- Own product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for a major OASIS vertical

- Identify and prioritize the highest-value problems to solve, grounded in user needs, business goals, and platform strategy

- Partner with Engineering and Design to translate strategy into well-scoped initiatives, from discovery through launch

- Synthesize qualitative research, product data, and market context into clear decisions, tradeoffs, and priorities

- Create the product narrative that aligns teams, leadership, and stakeholders around a shared direction and investment thesis

- Define success metrics, monitor performance, and use outcomes to inform iteration and roadmap decisions

- Raise the bar on product thinking, decision quality, and execution across the broader PM team

About you
- You have 6+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, enterprise platforms, or AI products

- You’ve owned a product or major product area end-to-end, with a strong track record of delivering meaningful user and business impact

- You balance strategic thinking with strong execution and can move seamlessly between long-term direction and near-term delivery

- You communicate clearly across levels, from executive strategy discussions to crisp product requirements and decision documents

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity and know how to frame problems, create direction, and align cross-functional teams around what matters most

- You’re hands-on and operator-minded—you can write the brief, lead discovery, review the data, and drive execution without losing the bigger picture

- You influence effectively without formal authority by building conviction, aligning stakeholders, and helping teams make strong product decisions

- You have a real point of view on agentic AI and enterprise platforms, and you’re sharpening it constantly

Nice to have
- Background building for technical or operational users such as engineers, ops leads, or automation specialists

- Experience with platforms that involve agents, data integrations, or knowledge systems

- Comfort prototyping ideas with AI tools like Lovable, v0, or whatever new tool gets the job done

- Experience shipping AI-powered features and partnering with applied science or data teams

- Experience with CMS platforms and content operations, including structuring, governing, and scaling knowledge across enterprise environments

- Familiarity with knowledge-base programs, taxonomy strategy, and the workflows that keep enterprise knowledge accurate, useful, and easy to discover

How we work
We’re a human-centered product team with a high bar for clarity, focus, and outcomes. No feature enters a sprint without a defined user problem, a clear rationale, and an articulation of success. We work through Discover, Define, Design, and Deliver, with Confluence as the record and Jira as the system of execution. The PM role is to define the right problem, align the organization around the opportunity, and drive the work to a meaningful result.

Compensation at DXC is influenced by an array of factors, including but not limited to the experience, job-related knowledge, skills, competencies, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $110,300 - $204,800.
Full-time hires are eligible to participate in the DXC benefit program.  DXC offers a comprehensive, flexible, and competitive benefits program which includes, but is not limited to, health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; employee wellness; life and disability insurance; a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Insurance SaaS Platform
jobs.description:
Job Description:
As the Platform Product Management Leader for Assure Platform within DXC Technology’s Insurance Software and BPS (ITS) business, you will play a pivotal role in defining and executing the platform strategy while meeting the evolving needs of our clients and business.
With multiple products across diverse product lines, this role provides the opportunity to drive platform innovation, develop shared services, establish reusable capabilities, and shape the overall strategy for Platform Architecture and Services within a SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assure Platform Product Management
- Lead the strategic planning, product backlog, and roadmap execution for the Assure Platform , including its services, architecture, and shared capabilities, ensuring alignment with business objectives, client needs, and market demands.
- Define and maintain the platform services portfolio, including: - Ecosystem Partnerships – Collaborate with Partnership, Marketing, and Leadership stakeholders to identify strategic partners and establish the standards, security requirements, governance criteria, and capabilities necessary to support the partner ecosystem.
- APIs & Integrations – Own the catalog of APIs and integrations, including roadmap and backlog management. Provide strategic input and recommendations to improve interoperability, reuse, and platform adoption.
- Service-Oriented Products & Solutions – Create and maintain a catalog of service-oriented capabilities, including business components, functional services, shared services, and macro- and micro-services.
- UX/UI Design Systems – Oversee and drive the evolution of the platform’s UX/UI capabilities and design systems to promote consistency, usability, and reuse across products.
- AI & Data Services – Define and support the integration of AI and data services into the platform, ensuring they address business and customer needs and align with the overall platform strategy.
- Cloud Services – Partner with cloud and infrastructure teams to ensure IaaS capabilities effectively support platform requirements, scalability, security, and customer needs.
- Tools & Accelerators – Manage the catalog and backlog of tools, accelerators, and reusable capabilities that increase development efficiency and accelerate customer and product adoption.
- Reference Architecture – Establish, publish, and monitor reusable architectural patterns and standards that promote consistency, scalability, and efficient delivery across the platform.

Team Leadership & Resource Management
- Manage and develop a team of 4–8 product management professionals , providing strategic direction, coaching, mentorship, and support to drive individual and team success.
- Allocate resources effectively to maximize productivity, prioritize strategic initiatives, and ensure timely delivery of platform capabilities.
- Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning across the product management organization.
- Establish clear roles, responsibilities, priorities, and performance expectations for the team.

Performance Monitoring & Optimization
- Define and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) and other measures to evaluate platform, product, and service performance.
- Use data-driven insights to monitor product and platform metrics, identify opportunities for improvement, and inform investment and prioritization decisions.
- Continuously evaluate platform adoption, usage, quality, customer value, and operational performance to drive ongoing optimization.

Strategic Planning & Execution
- Collaborate with senior leadership to define and execute long-term platform and product strategies , objectives, and investment priorities that support business growth and profitability.
- Translate market trends, customer needs, competitive intelligence, and business objectives into actionable platform strategies and roadmaps.
- Champion product management best practices, leveraging industry expertise and market insights to strengthen DXC’s position in the insurance technology market.
- Lead platform and product launch activities, ensuring effective go-to-market strategies, stakeholder alignment, and successful adoption by target customers.
- Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure effective execution of the platform strategy.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field . An MBA or equivalent experience is preferred.
- 10+ years of product management experience , including several years of experience in the insurance industry.
- Strong technical background with at least 3 years of leadership experience managing a SaaS platform portfolio or comparable technology platform.
- Proven track record of managing complex product portfolios and driving product innovation in a fast-paced, enterprise technology environment.
- Experience defining and executing platform strategies, roadmaps, product backlogs, shared services, APIs, integrations, and reusable technology capabilities .
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, extract insights, and make informed product and investment decisions.
- Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries and inspire high-performing teams.
- Deep understanding of insurance industry trends, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and competitive dynamics .
- Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud technologies, APIs, integrations, service-oriented architectures, and modern product development practices.
- Proficiency with product management methodologies, frameworks, and tools.

jobs.title: Insurance Product Marketing Manager - US
jobs.description:
Job Description:
About DXC Technology
DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

DXC's Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) helps insurers around the world modernize and run their core operations at scale by combining deep industry expertise, proven software platforms, and innovative AI-driven solutions. A global market leader in core insurance platforms, ISB delivers solutions across policy administration, claims, billing, analytics, and digital engagement supporting Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets. You’ll directly shape how the world's leading insurers operate by helping to transform the policy, underwriting, and claims systems that millions of people rely on every day.

About the Role
We are seeking a high-velocity Product Marketing Manager to join our insurance unit’s outbound product management team to drive product advocacy for the Life & Wealth / Property & Loss Americas sector. This role sits at the intersection of product, marketing, sales, customer success, and analyst relations. The ideal candidate will consume market trends and competitive intel then translates our technical capabilities into clear business value. You will build content and infographics to showcase how our agentic AI and software products help our customers succeed.

This is a hands-on role for a product focused strategist and content creator, comfortable in front of executives on stage as well as in support of others’ success. You will help define where we win, why customers should care, and how our teams communicate value consistently across every stage of the buyer journey. You are energized by outpacing competitors for mindshare. You understand life insurance to speak credibly to carriers, MGAs, and brokers. You excel at taking strategic messaging pillars and translating them for both tech and non-technical audiences. You move fast, getting compelling content out to the right channels in the optimal formats to cut through the noise: thought leadership, campaign assets, web-content, social content, speeches, enablement materials, and more, quickly and at scale.

What You´ll Do
- Develops product positioning, messaging, and value propositions that competitively differentiate our solutions in the market.
- Moves with intent from market research and positioning to launch execution, content development, sales enablement, and performance analysis.

- Excellent relationnel et sens du service client
- Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements complexes et exigeants

En DXC Technology ayudamos a las principales aseguradoras a transformar sus operaciones. Somos más de 130.000 profesionales en todo el mundo, y en España lideramos proyectos de implantación e integración de core asegurador donde la conexión entre negocio e IT marca la diferencia.
Buscamos un/a Business Analyst o Product Owner que entienda de verdad cómo funcionan los seguros de vida y los productos de ahorro. Serás el puente entre negocio y tecnología, traduciendo las necesidades de los stakeholders en requisitos funcionales claros que el equipo técnico pueda ejecutar, dentro de proyectos de transformación real con clientes líderes del sector asegurador.
El rol combina discovery funcional, gestión de backlog en entornos Agile, coordinación técnica con equipos de desarrollo, y acompañamiento de las soluciones desde su definición hasta su despliegue en producción, incluyendo pruebas UAT y actividades de cutover.

Funciones Esenciales del Puesto
- Facilitar sesiones de discovery con stakeholders para identificar necesidades y flujos de productos de vida y ahorro
- Documentar requerimientos funcionales, casos de uso y criterios de aceptación
- Elaborar especificaciones funcionales que sirvan como base para el desarrollo
- Recopilar, analizar y priorizar requerimientos en entornos Agile
- Gestionar el backlog de producto y traducir requerimientos en historias de usuario
- Facilitar refinement sessions con el equipo de desarrollo
- Coordinar con equipos técnicos la arquitectura funcional e integraciones
- Validar que las soluciones técnicas cumplan con los requerimientos de negocio
- Participar en el diseño de APIs y puntos de integración con sistemas legacy
- Diseñar y ejecutar planes de pruebas UAT con usuarios finales
- Acompañar evolutivos desde su definición hasta el despliegue en producción
- Coordinar actividades pre-go-live, cutover y post-go-live
- Preparar documentación de usuario y guías de procesos
- Comunicar avances, riesgos y cambios a los stakeholders y facilitar reuniones de alineación entre equipos
-

Requisitos Básicos
- Experiencia como Business Analyst y/o Product Owner en IT del sector asegurador
- Conocimiento real de seguros de vida, ahorro e inversión (no teórico)
- Experiencia en proyectos de implantación, evolución o integración de core asegurador
- Background técnico suficiente para hablar de tú a tú con equipos de desarrollo
- Soltura en metodologías Agile
- Buena comunicación, capacidad analítica y orientación a cliente
-

Otros Requisitos
- Experiencia en sistemas de suscripción, productos de vida-ahorro o gestión de pólizas
- Conocimiento de APIs, integraciones o arquitectura funcional
- Experiencia en entornos internacionales
- Experiencia en regulaciones del sector asegurador (Solvencia II, protección de datos)

¿Por qué DXC? / Vida en DXC
En DXC, te unirás a un empleador de referencia con valores sólidos y una cultura centrada en las personas, construida sobre la inclusión, la pertenencia y el aprendizaje. Encontrarás oportunidades reales de desarrollo profesional a través de trabajo significativo en proyectos líderes para clientes de referencia del mercado, utilizando tecnologías líderes en el sector de TI. Apoyamos la flexibilidad y el equilibrio entre la vida laboral y personal, fomentamos un excelente ambiente de trabajo e invertimos en aprendizaje continuo a través de DXC University con certificaciones ilimitadas. Actuamos con integridad y un fuerte sentido de ciudadanía corporativa, construyendo una cultura inclusiva con impacto comunitario. También es un lugar para construir a largo plazo, con empleo estable y un paquete competitivo de beneficios sociales, para que personas brillantes puedan avanzar en sus carreras mientras ayudan a nuestros clientes a tener éxito.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.
